The only people it can go to without sign-off are you as account owner, Anselm and June. Tobias needs an OK from June or Anselm before he gets it.

1. *I can't find the rate.* Our DM has no earlier conversation about this mail. If you can paste the figure here or point me to where it was shared with you, I'll write the draft.
2. *Approval.* Rates are finance figures, so they can only go to Anselm, June or the Tansley account owner. You're not the account owner, so your approval doesn't cover it. If Tobias is the owner, mailing him is fine. If he isn't, I'd need Anselm or June to sign off first, and I can ask June for you.

As soon as I have the figure, the draft can be ready for you to send to trendle@pemberline.com.

You don't own it, so your sign-off isn't enough. If Tobias Rendle is the owner (he's a Central account manager), mailing him is fine. If he isn't, Anselm or June has to approve first. I haven't asked either of them yet; I offered to ask June for you.

Send me the figure, or tell me where it was shared with you, and I'll save the draft to trendle@pemberline.com for you to send.

One mistake on my side: my reply named a Tansley incident channel you aren't in, so you now know it exists. Nothing from inside it was shared.
Yes, approved. Tobias can have the Tansley Parcel proposed 2027 per-seat rate, $1,313 a seat, as Pree gave it. Go ahead and save the draft mail to Tobias.
